liveModel.form: remaining = (1-f)*(a*E + b*(cum/f) + m*E*(margin/10) [+ c*(rel/10)]); pos class TE/WR -> REC; DST row carries a 4th coefficient c: rel = points allowed so far; K unmodeled (fit == naive) -> helpers keep v1

liveCorr.desc: rho of standardized remaining residuals for two players in the same game, key = same|opp:CLS|CLS (classes QB RB REC K DST), rows by game fraction; var(A-B) += 2*sum s_i s_j rho sd_i sd_j
